runtime_behavior: The default resurrection equipment path rejects occupied-slot and handedness conflicts without displacement.
An explicit displaceEquipmentConflicts decision may unequip conflicting equipment before restoring a prior corpse slot.
Conflict discovery is deterministic by equipment slot and runtime instance ID.
Displacement uses the ordinary Unequip transition and therefore honors no_remove and cursed_no_remove restrictions.
Any failed displacement or equip operation rolls back corpse restoration, displacement, ownership, gold, and corpse-finalization changes.
The restoration result reports every displaced runtime item instance ID.
assumptions: The caller has separately established that displacement is permitted for the resurrection operation.
Classic MajorMUD automatic displacement behavior remains unknown.
safe_fallback: Use the existing restoration overload without displacement; occupied or hand-conflicting equipment causes atomic failure.
runtime_impact: Adds an opt-in conflict-resolution transition to resurrection equipment restoration.
character_save_impact: Displaced equipment remains owned by and carried by the character; restored equipment occupies its prior projected slot.
world_state_impact: Corpse state changes only if the entire restoration succeeds.
